methodology: First-pass verse-specific comparison of Qur'an 6:81-90 with possible earlier textual antecedents. Qur'anic text inspected; earlier locators are leads NOT checked against original-language critical editions. No claim of literary dependence or exhaustive absence. Composition dates and manuscript witness dates must be independently documented before promotion.
coverage_ledger_status: Draft checkpoint only; reconcile with main and other open PRs into one authoritative per-ayah ledger.

entries.summary: Abraham questions fear of idols versus unauthorized association
entries.caveat: Shared critique of powerless idols; Jeremiah does not preserve Abraham's dialogue.

entries.summary: Security of faith unmingled with wrongdoing
entries.caveat: General moral assurance; no distinctive prior narrative identified in first pass.

entries.summary: God grants Abraham an argument against his people
entries.caveat: Joshua remembers ancestral idolatry; midrash portrays dispute, but neither is a verbatim equivalent.

entries.summary: Isaac Jacob Noah David Solomon Job Joseph Moses Aaron listed as guided
entries.caveat: Named persons appear in distinct older accounts; Quranic list is a theological genealogy, not one source's narrative sequence.

entries.summary: Zechariah John Jesus Elijah named righteous
entries.caveat: Different chronological figures and source genres; not a shared four-person episode.

entries.summary: Ishmael Elisha Jonah Lot named as favored
entries.caveat: Person-specific antecedents, but no single equivalent roster or common story.

entries.summary: Selection of fathers descendants and brothers
entries.caveat: Broad election language; no specific earlier passage established.

entries.summary: Guidance and warning that association nullifies deeds
entries.caveat: Covenant warning resembles a motif; scope and language differ.

entries.summary: Scripture judgment and prophethood entrusted to guided figures
entries.caveat: Prophetic authorization motif; verse is a collective retrospective unlike Deuteronomy's individual promise.

entries.summary: Follow earlier prophets' guidance and ask no payment
entries.caveat: No-payment/uncorrupted leadership comparison is loose, not evidence of dependence.
